zh-CN.title: 一滴日记，分享进聊天
items: 应用与工具正式加入 Drop · 一滴，可连接账号、管理授权并打开应用。
聊天操作栏新增一滴入口，选择日记与公开字段，确认后分享至当前会话。

en.title: Share diary moments from Drop
items: Drop joins Apps & tools with account connection and authorization management.
Choose diary entries and sharing fields from the chat toolbar, then confirm sharing to your current chat.
